stem.text: A rock in deep space is travelling towards a distant star and collides with a stationary spacecraft.
What is **not** a possible outcome of the collision?

A.text: The rock becomes stationary and the spacecraft moves towards the star.

B.text: The rock moves away from the star and so does the spacecraft.

C.text: The rock moves away from the star and the spacecraft moves towards the star.

D.text: The rock moves towards the star and so does the spacecraft.
